name: Maintenance Report
description: Report maintenance or housekeeping tasks
labels: ["maintenance"]
body: |
  ## Maintenance Description
  A clear and concise description of the maintenance task.
  
  ## Reason for Maintenance
  Explain why this maintenance is needed.
  
  ## Proposed Changes
  Describe the changes you'd make.
  
  ## Impact Assessment
  Assess the impact of these changes.
  
  ## Additional Context
  Add any other context about the maintenance task.
